faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Thalassery District Court Office Attendant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Office Attendant posts is 30th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for the Office Attendant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Office Attendant position is 62 years. There is no minimum age limit specified for retired personnel applying for this role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Office Attendant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Office Attendant post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,280 per month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria require candidates to be retired from courts or similar government departments. This is the primary qualification for the Office Attendant role.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Office Attendant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Office Attendant position in the Thalassery District Court recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Thalassery District Court Office Attendant Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Office Attendant role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial scrutiny of applications, followed by the preparation of a merit list, and finally, document verification for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is A1-15524/2026. Candidates should refer to this number when submitting their applications.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Thalassery District Court. Links are provided in the Important Links section of this article.
